_notes.kind: 'defect' = pass/fail; passes only if every entry in `source` passes. Hard sources (frameDiff, blankFrame, audit:*) decide; `judge` covers what can't be measured. 'fidelity' = the judge compares the shot with each of `references` along `aspect`, returns ranked gaps, and passes only when no high/medium gap remains.
_notes.fields: `shot` names a canvas shot, page shot or `tileSheet`; `segment` names a timeline segment. `crop: true` sends a zoomed crop. `marks` draws numbered marks from the named audit field.
_notes.references: References show style, materials, lighting and density, not layout. Judges ignore board shape, tile arrangement and elevation differences that come from the game rules.
_notes.views: `views` makes an item resolve once per view and pass only if every view passes. `{view}` in a shot name expands per view (ui-{view} -> ui-2d, ui-3d). For gameplay items `segment` names a gameplay script; `at: "after-step"` grades the settled full-page frame after each step.

items.text: Board reads as a flat 2D map: no perspective skew, tiles edge-to-edge with no gaps
No frame where geometry vanishes, flickers or goes blank
Props, slab and water rise continuously with the terrain; nothing pops in at once; no cracks between tiles
A slab edge is visible under the board along its whole perimeter
Cliff textures are not stretched
No floating trees, rocks or props
Foam at waterfall crest and base is visible; water flows downhill
The bridge arch is unobstructed in frame and spans the river with water visibly flowing under it
Meeples sit on their features, not floating
Every tile feature meets its edge midpoint
HUD never covers the board, text is legible, nothing overflows or overlaps
Each placed tile visibly drops or slides into the correct cell and settles flush with its neighbors; no pop-in, jump, wrong cell or seam
Each placed meeple animates onto its claimed feature and ends seated on it in the player's color
Completing a feature is visibly signalled (highlight or score popup near the feature) and its meeples return to supply
After every step the HUD shows the correct current player, tiles remaining, scores and meeple supply
Legal placements are highlighted on the correct cells and readable in this view; the rotate button visibly rotates the tile in the dock
No console errors or exceptions during scripted play
Clicking the 2D/3D pill morphs smoothly both ways; the pill state matches the view; the HUD stays put and the board stays framed

items.aspect: Environment: the board floats in an open, bright sky with soft volumetric clouds around and below it; no flat void, dark background or ground plane under it
items.text: Board floats in a cloudy sky like the reference

items.aspect: Cross-section slab: grass lip overhanging the edge, a thick brown soil band, blue-slate rock strata below, irregular eroded edges and texture, tapering underside
items.text: Slab cross-section matches the reference's layered earth and rock

items.aspect: City: cream limestone curtain walls with crenellations, round towers with conical blue-slate roofs, dense mix of terracotta and slate pitched roofs inside the walls, buildings with visible detail
items.text: Walled city matches the reference's architecture and density

items.aspect: Ground cover and vegetation: tufted, textured meadow grass with color variation; clustered mixed conifer and broadleaf trees and shrubs at similar density and scale; cobblestone roads with edging; cottages with terracotta roofs
items.text: Meadow, trees, roads and cottages match the reference's detail and density

items.aspect: Lighting and color: warm low-angle sunlight, soft cast shadows from walls, trees and buildings, ambient occlusion in crevices, gentle atmospheric depth, saturated but natural palette
items.text: Lighting and palette match the reference

items.aspect: 2D tiles: features read like Carcassonne tiles (city segments, roads, fields, monasteries), painted with the reference diorama's palette and materials
items.text: Tile art matches both references

items.aspect: HUD layout and style: turn indicator top-left, 2D/3D pill toggle top-center, a tall frosted-glass panel on the right holding current tile with count, meeple supply, a rotate button and score; clean sans-serif type; the board stays the visual focus. Extra controls are fine if they follow this style
items.text: HUD matches the reference layout and style
